title: Small Business Saturday - Small Business Administration

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday is observed on Saturday, November 28, 2026.
facts.quote: Champion small businesses nationwide and #ShopSmall on Saturday, November 28, 2026.

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday was founded by American Express in 2010 and officially cosponsored by the SBA since 2011.
facts.quote: Small Business Saturday was founded by American Express in 2010 and officially cosponsored by SBA since 2011.

facts.fact: The SBA states that the nation has more than 36.2 million independent businesses.
facts.quote: Support our nation’s more than 36.2 million independent businesses this Small Business Saturday and all holiday season long.

facts.fact: The SBA Million Dollar Pitch Competition has five small business owners competing for a share of $1 million in cash prizes.
facts.quote: Five small business owners battle for a share of $1 million in cash prizes.

facts.fact: SBA's cosponsorship of Small Business Saturday is covered by Cosponsorship Authorization #26-33-C.
